verdict.rationale: Tavily covers each step of the flow under one API and SDK: Search and Extract endpoints (up to 20 URLs per batch, with per-URL failure reporting), plus a Research endpoint that runs multiple searches, analyzes sources and produces a detailed report. Research offers mini/pro modes, async status retrieval and streaming, and session/user identifiers support attribution across multi-step agent workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end research and synthesis quality, since all evidence is first-party docs/SDK.
